column1: # Known attacks on GitHub accounts, repos and tooling: indicators read by
# Last reviewed: 2026-11-18. Indicators go stale within weeks; re-check the sources below
# on every release of this skill and add new campaigns as rows.
# Columns (tab-separated): kind  pattern  confidence  campaign  note
#   kind        commit   commit subject, extended regex, case-sensitive
#               path     file path in a repo or skill, extended regex
#               content  text inside workflows, scripts, package.json or skill files, extended regex
#               action   a GitHub Action reference in a workflow's uses:, extended regex
#               git_fixed  lowest patched Git version in each release line (pattern = version)
# Patterns that are literal strings are written with one character in brackets (b42...24[9])
# so this file, and the scripts, never match their own indicators when a skill is scanned.
#   confidence  high (only seen in the attack), medium (attack-specific but seen elsewhere),
#               low (generic: read the commit before concluding anything)
#   GhostAction: o3.security and akeyless.io pages above (C2 address only)
#   Actions: CVE-2025-30066 (tj-actions/changed-files), CVE-2025-30154 (reviewdog), Trivy action tag hijack (March 2026)
